questions.question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8301e0e8e4527b4068d88f39c023c422c2d7237bc5e44bc5fc369291cb6009.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

1) HJL → H + 2 = J, J + 2 = L

2) SUV → S + 2 = U, U + 2 = **W ≠ V**

3) BDF → B + 2 = D, D + 2 = F

4) NPR → N + 2 = P, P + 2 = R

Hence, “SUV” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many triangles are present in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1c77a36c3ad0b282a670a205a375c6c861902b60b192f93014c194f0a1717a8.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f8892e089b0d5df1e871c866f16f981559fb22699eaa488193ca1c9db59b445.png] 

When a triangle is divided in different bases, then count the number of triangles and add them all.

In triangle ABD, we have two bases = BC and CD ⇒ 3 triangles

In triangle BGD, we have two bases = GI and ID ⇒ 3 triangles

In triangle EGH, we have two bases = GF and FE ⇒ 3 triangles

The last triangle remaining is GED.

Thus, total triangles = 3 + 3 + 3 + 1 = 10

Hence, “10” is the correct answer.

Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

Ginger : Stem : : Chilli : ?
questions.solution:
Ginger : Stem → Ginger is a stem.

Chilli : ?

By going through the options:

1) Fruit → Chilli will be considered as fruit.

2) Flower → Chilli is not a flower.

3) Root → Chilli never grows in soil.

4) Stem → Chilli is not a stem.

After, removing the last three options, we are left with only “Fruit”. So, Chilli is considered as a fruit.

Hence, “fruit” is the correct answer.

questions.question: If RUBY is coded as 264 and PAY is coded as 126, then how will RUPAY be coded as?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8301e0e8e4527b4068d88f39c023c422c2d7237bc5e44bc5fc369291cb6009.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

RUBY → 18 + 21 + 2 + 25 = 66 and 66 × 4 = 264 where 4 is the no. of letters in the word RUBY.

PAY → 16 + 1 + 25 = 42 and 42 × 3 = 126 where 3 is the no. of letters in the word PAY.

Similarly,

RUPAY → 18 + 21 + 16 + 1 + 25 = 81 and 81 × 5 = 405 where 5 is the no. of letters in the word RUPAY.

Hence, 405 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Important : Essential
questions.solution:
The pattern is as follows:

Important : Essential → Essential and Important are synonyms.

1) Never : Always → Never and Always are antonyms.

2) Up : Down → Up and Down are antonyms.

3) Pick : Drop → Pick and Drop are antonyms.

4) Awful : Horrible → Awful and Horrible are synonyms.

Hence, “Awful : Horrible” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All eggs are hens.

All hens are birds.

All birds are crows.

**Conclusions:**

I. All eggs are crows.

II. All hens are crows.

III. Some crows are birds.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow.
All conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusion II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81a868a1174f42829caa6a45f0e8e2f8bb18cfd87be66ccd1bf009982f3551ba.png] 

**Explanation:**

I. All eggs are crows → True (All eggs are hens, which are birds, which in turn are crows. So, all eggs are crows is true).

II. All hens are crows → True (All hens are birds, which are crows. So, all hens are crows is true).

III. Some crows are birds → True (All birds are crows. So, some part of crows will be birds)

Hence, “All conclusions I, II and III follow” is the correct answer.

questions.question: What will be the day of the week on 15 August 2021?
questions.solution:
Till 2000, odd days = 0 (2000 is a century leap year)

Odd days in 20 years (from 2001 to 2020) = (No. of leap years × 2 + no. of non-leap years × 1) mod 7 = (5 × 2 + 15 × 1) mod 7 = remainder of (25 ÷ 7) = 4

2021 is a non-leap year

Odd days in 2021 → (odd days in jan + odd days in feb + odd days in march + odd days in april + odd days in may + odd days in june + odd days in july + odd days till 15 august) mod 7

Odd days = 3 + 0 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 17 odd days = 17 ÷ 7 = 3 days

Total odd days = 4 odd days + 3 odd days = 7 odd days

Total odd days = 7 ÷ 7 = 0 (remainder) → 0 odd days
